title: Travel Nurse vs. Staff Nurse Comp
description: True net-pay comparison of travel nursing against a permanent staff post. Stacks a caller-asserted tax-free housing stipend and M&IE allowance against contract gap weeks, per-contract travel cost and out-of-pocket housing shortfall; reports staff net excluding benefits, travel net, the annual delta, the counterfactual stipend tax savings, the gap-week opportunity cost and the effective all-in travel hourly rate. NOT TAX ADVICE: the excludability of the stipends is supplied by the caller and is not determined here. Every input is read as parseFloat(value) || page-default, so a literal 0, a blank or a non-numeric value silently reverts to the tool default instead of computing as zero; the response names every substitution in compliance_flags and in output_payload.inputs_defaulted. No range validation is applied. No clock is read. Adjacent to art-338-compute-federal-withholding (which owns federal withholding on the taxable wage lines) and NOT an implementation of art-340.

staffRate.description: Staff hourly rate, USD/hr. Multiplied by staffHours and staffWeeks for staff gross. page default 38; the literal 0 is falsy and reverts to that default.

staffHours.description: Staff hours worked per week. staffGrossAnnual = staffRate x staffHours x staffWeeks. page default 36; 0 reverts to the default.

staffBenefits.description: Annual value of the staff benefits package, USD/yr. Reported in staffNetAnnual and in the results table, but EXCLUDED from the winner test, which compares travelNetAnnual against staffNetNoFringe. page default 12000; 0 reverts to the default.

staffWeeks.description: Weeks worked per year on the staff post. page default 50; 0 reverts to the default.

taxRate.description: Assumed effective tax rate expressed as a PERCENT; the kernel divides by 100 before use. 0 becomes 0/100 = 0, which is falsy, so it reverts to the default 22 -- there is no way to express a 0% effective rate through this input. page default 22.

travelBase.description: Taxable hourly base rate on the travel contract, USD/hr. travelTaxableAnnual = travelBase x travelHours x weeksWorked. page default 22; 0 reverts to the default.

housingStipend.description: Weekly housing stipend, USD/week, ASSUMED tax-free. The kernel does not establish that this is excludable; see CITES.md. page default 1200; 0 reverts to the default, so a zero stipend is unreachable.

mieStipend.description: Weekly meals and incidental expenses allowance, USD/week, ASSUMED tax-free. page default 350; 0 reverts to the default, so a zero allowance is unreachable.

contractWeeks.description: Weeks per travel contract. weeksWorked = contractWeeks x contractsPerYear. page default 13; 0 reverts to the default, which is one of the three reasons totalHoursWorked can never equal 0.

contractsPerYear.description: Travel contracts worked per year. Multiplies contractWeeks into weeksWorked, and multiplies travelCost into travelTravelCostAnnual. page default 3; 0 reverts to the default.

gapWeeks.description: Unpaid gap weeks between contracts. Enters ONLY totalAnnualGapWeeks -> gapCost, priced at the staff rate. It does NOT subtract from travelNetAnnual. page default 3; 0 reverts to the default.

travelHours.description: Hours worked per week on travel. A factor of totalHoursWorked, the divisor of effectiveHourly, and of travelTaxableAnnual and gapCost. page default 36; 0 reverts to the default, so the effectiveHourly guard cannot be reached at zero hours.

travelCost.description: Travel and moving cost per contract, USD. travelTravelCostAnnual = travelCost x contractsPerYear. page default 1500; 0 reverts to the default, so a free move is unreachable.

ttpHousingCost.description: Out-of-pocket housing shortfall, USD/week, i.e. housing cost not covered by the stipend. ttpHousingCostAnnual = ttpHousingCost x weeksWorked. page default 200; 0 reverts to the default.

input_schema.x_apexport_required_note: required is empty on purpose. All fourteen inputs are unconditionally dereferenced by the compute, but none of them is mandatory: every one has a defined page default, and the default-substitution path is itself load-bearing behaviour under test (boundary pairs B01-B14). Requiring all fourteen would make both the default path and the zero-swallow unreachable through the schema and would silently change the ported tool. A caller that wants the Apex defaults sends {} or null. Flagged for the trusted builder as OPEN-1 in APEXPORT-132-REPORT.md.

staffRate.description: The RESOLVED value. If the input was 0, blank or non-numeric this is the page default, not the supplied number.

taxRate.description: The RESOLVED rate as a fraction, not a percent.

stipendTaxSavings.description: A counterfactual on an ASSERTED treatment: what the stipends would have cost had they been taxed at taxRate. Not a tax computation.

gapCost.description: Opportunity cost of the unpaid gap weeks, priced at the STAFF hourly rate.

effectiveHourly.description: travelNetAnnual / totalHoursWorked when totalHoursWorked > 0, else the literal 0.

totalAnnualGapWeeks.description: gapWeeks x contractsPerYear. Page local; not in the page's own _lastResult.

totalHoursWorked.description: travelHours x weeksWorked. Page local; not in the page's own _lastResult.

travelWins.description: travelNetAnnual > staffNetNoFringe, STRICT. An exact tie reports travel as the loser.

inputs_defaulted.description: Names every input for which the page `|| default` guard fired.
